name: Be MY Guest
source:
You Are Invited!! Katey is throwing a surprise Halloween Party for her friends in Black Cat Town.

And you, as her best friend, is definitely invited.

However, what truly awaits you is something you might not have imagined it to be.

Have a fun, exciting, horror and spooky night of wizardry!

[From [url=https://nightcatmeow.itch.io/be-my-guest]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你收到邀请了！！Katey要在黑猫镇为朋友们举办一场惊喜万圣节派对。

身为她最好的朋友，你当然也在受邀之列。

然而，真正等着你的，或许并非你所想象的那样。

祝你度过一个欢乐刺激、充满魔法与惊悚气氛的夜晚！

[来源：[url=https://nightcatmeow.itch.io/be-my-guest]Itch.io[/url]]
